svg.text: PostgreSQL | public schema | 16 application tables | 9 enforced foreign keys
PK = primary key | FK = foreign key | UQ = unique column | ? = nullable | bar = one | circle = optional | fork = many
Independent tables | no declared foreign-key relationships
These tables intentionally remain unconnected. Internal _prisma_migrations is omitted.
Connections reflect database constraints only. article_revisions.editedById and activity_logs.targetId are not foreign keys.
